title: Learn a physical rotation from two adaptive contrast axes
statement: The actual signed record F=6 s b e_a e_j^T has conditional mean R diag(lambda_X,0,lambda_Z), with both observed contrasts at least kappa and no Y margin. Proper SO(3) curvature controls the missing axis. A finite rational quaternion/Jacobi fit remains exactly physical on all bad histories, and every failed matching still pays the full fine schedule and replacement.

Fresh service payload/reference independent of source at the service boundary; uniform complete calibration/service implementation allowances

assumptions: Condition only on the complete prior record; within-shot learners can be correlated
An improper polar factor could reverse Y without changing the two observed axes

costs: Fixed N0+N1 calibration block calls plus one service, each block preparing q inputs and measuring all n outputs
Rational 4x4 quaternion/Jacobi fitting, local inverse controls, physical failure replacement, random-bit caps, optional frames and paid routing/storage
contract.units: Bell loss/global Bell-test failure and averaged half-diamond or permitted strategy distance only where the source supplies that conversion. Block calls, total qubit traffic, bits, controls, routing and memory are separate.
